Container.Name: Sylo-Fluxer
Container.Overview:
Sylo-Fluxer is a multi-function bot for Fluxer (https://fluxer.app) with a web dashboard - a port of Sylo. It has a per-community module system: moderation with warning thresholds and a numbered case log, server logging, tickets/modmail answered from the dashboard, reaction roles & autoroles, verification (react to verify, or a Cloudflare Turnstile captcha), welcome/leave messages, birthdays, sticky messages, auto-moderation, counting, custom commands, an autoresponder, reminders, leveling (text + voice XP), AFK, server statistics, server insights, free games, ban appeals, temporary voice channels, a starboard, an invite tracker, polls, giveaways, game stats, Twitch / YouTube / Kick / RSS alerts, scheduled channel cleanup and a message/embed creator. Commands are typed with a prefix (! by default, changeable per community). State is stored in a single SQLite file under /app/data and survives updates; it is snapshotted automatically into /app/data/backups.
Setup: in the Fluxer app open User Settings -> Developer -> Applications, create an application, then set FLUXER_TOKEN (Bot token) and FLUXER_CLIENT_ID (Application ID). Invite the bot with https://web.fluxer.app/oauth2/authorize?client_id=YOUR_APPLICATION_ID&scope=bot&permissions=1100469103831
Dashboard: runs open by default (use only on a trusted LAN). To require "Log in with Fluxer" for community admins, set FLUXER_CLIENT_SECRET and add http://[UNRAID-IP]:[HOST-PORT]/auth/fluxer/callback to the application's Redirect URIs.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Host port for the Sylo dashboard. Only change the host side; the container always listens on 3000.

Config.Name: Data Directory
Config.Description: Where the SQLite database (sylo.db) is stored. Persists across updates/restarts.

Config.Name: FLUXER_TOKEN
Config.Description: Fluxer bot token (User Settings -> Developer -> Applications -> your app -> Bot token).

Config.Name: FLUXER_CLIENT_ID
Config.Description: Fluxer Application ID (top of the same page).

Config.Name: FLUXER_SHARD_COUNT
Config.Description: Optional. Number of gateway shards this one container runs. Leave blank (or 'auto') - it stays at 1 until the bot is in ~2,500+ communities. Multi-process sharding is not supported.

Config.Name: FLUXER_CLIENT_SECRET
Config.Description: Optional. Set this (same page -> Client secret) to require 'Log in with Fluxer' on the dashboard, restricted to community admins. Also add http://[UNRAID-IP]:[HOST-PORT]/auth/fluxer/callback to the application's Redirect URIs. Leave blank to run the dashboard open (trusted LAN only).

Config.Name: FLUXER_API_URL
Config.Description: Optional, self-hosted Fluxer only. Public API origin of your instance. Leave blank for hosted Fluxer (fluxer.app).

Config.Name: FLUXER_WEB_URL
Config.Description: Optional, self-hosted Fluxer only. Web app origin of your instance. Leave blank for hosted Fluxer.

Config.Name: DASHBOARD_URL
Config.Description: Optional. The public dashboard URL (e.g. https://sylo.example.com or http://[UNRAID-IP]:[HOST-PORT]). Needed behind a reverse proxy for the OAuth2 redirect URI, and to build the links members open for verification-captcha and ban appeals. Leave blank for direct IP access without those features.

Config.Name: TURNSTILE_SITE_KEY
Config.Description: Optional. Cloudflare Turnstile site key — enables the Verification module's captcha mode. Free at dash.cloudflare.com -> Turnstile. Needs both keys and DASHBOARD_URL set; otherwise captcha mode falls back to a plain Verify button.

Config.Name: TURNSTILE_SECRET_KEY
Config.Description: Optional. Cloudflare Turnstile secret key — pairs with TURNSTILE_SITE_KEY for the Verification captcha.

Config.Name: ITAD_API_KEY
Config.Description: Optional. IsThereAnyDeal API key (free at isthereanydeal.com/apps) — broadens the Free games module beyond the Epic Games Store to Steam, GOG, Fanatical, Humble and more. Without it, Free games is Epic-only.

Config.Name: TWITCH_CLIENT_ID
Config.Description: Optional. Twitch application client id for the Twitch alerts module ('go live' notifications). Free app at dev.twitch.tv/console. Needs TWITCH_CLIENT_SECRET too; without both, the module's poll loop does nothing.

Config.Name: TWITCH_CLIENT_SECRET
Config.Description: Optional. Twitch application client secret, paired with TWITCH_CLIENT_ID for the Twitch alerts module.

Config.Name: KICK_CLIENT_ID
Config.Description: Optional. Kick application client id for the Kick alerts module ('go live' notifications). Free app at kick.com/settings/developer. Needs KICK_CLIENT_SECRET too; without both, the module's poll loop does nothing.

Config.Name: KICK_CLIENT_SECRET
Config.Description: Optional. Kick application client secret, paired with KICK_CLIENT_ID for the Kick alerts module.

Config.Name: STATS_CACHE_TTL_MINUTES
Config.Description: How long (minutes) to cache a stats lookup before hitting the API again.

Config.Name: GAMETOOLS_API_BASE
Config.Description: Base URL of the Battlefield stats API.

Config.Name: DATABASE_PATH
Config.Description: Path to the SQLite file inside the container. Must sit inside the Data Directory mount.

Config.Name: BACKUP_INTERVAL_HOURS
Config.Description: How often (hours) to write an automatic compacted database snapshot into <Data Directory>/backups. A snapshot is also always taken just before a schema migration, and on demand from the Health page. Set to 0 to disable the scheduled backup.

Config.Name: BACKUP_RETENTION
Config.Description: How many database snapshots to keep in <Data Directory>/backups. Older ones are pruned automatically.

Config.Name: BACKUP_DIR
Config.Description: Optional. Directory (inside the container) for database snapshots. Leave blank to use <Data Directory>/backups; must sit inside the Data Directory mount if set.

Config.Name: BACKUP_WEBDAV_URL
Config.Description: Optional. Off-site backups: a WebDAV folder URL (e.g. a Nextcloud path like https://cloud.example.com/remote.php/dav/files/me/sylo-backups). After every local snapshot a gzipped copy is PUT to <url>/<name>.db.gz. Best-effort and logged; never blocks the local backup.

Config.Name: BACKUP_WEBDAV_USER
Config.Description: Optional. Username for BACKUP_WEBDAV_URL (HTTP basic auth). Use an app password, not your account password.

Config.Name: BACKUP_WEBDAV_PASS
Config.Description: Optional. Password / app password for BACKUP_WEBDAV_URL.

Config.Name: BACKUP_WEBHOOK_URL
Config.Description: Optional. Off-site backups: a webhook URL. Each gzipped snapshot is uploaded as an attachment (skipped when it is over ~8 MiB — use WebDAV for a larger database).

Config.Name: WEB_PORT
Config.Description: Port the app listens on inside the container. Leave at 3000 unless you also change the container side of the WebUI Port mapping.

Config.Name: NODE_ENV
Config.Description: Node environment.

Config.Name: LOG_LEVEL
Config.Description: Log verbosity: debug, info, warn or error. debug also emits one line per HTTP request.

Config.Name: LOG_FORMAT
Config.Description: Log line format: text or json (LOG_JSON=1 is shorthand for json).

Config.Name: TZ
Config.Description: IANA timezone name, used for timestamps in ticket transcripts and logs. Defaults to Europe/Oslo.
